ASAP7 synthesis and pre-CTS placement

Provisional offline snapshot. PNG links open embedded post-placement images; no local files are required. Values come from the retained serial measurements.

lhdtrack corpus · host llmHDL · run 20261020-placement-resynthesis3 · RVT / TT NLDM.
livehd 427b1de15 opt sha256:761c8479ecfbc254

Every column reads the same frozen Verilog, merged Liberty and corpus SDC. LiveHD follows the ABC / compile SAT disabled profile in results-syn-satsuma.html: default coloring and arithmetic selection, SDC-derived mapping delay, native memory preservation. These are fresh measurements on this host; no timing or memory numbers are imported from satsuma. All LiveHD invocations use aegraph folding; placement sets synth.place.fp=false for these small designs. Baseline-versus-aegraph comparisons remain in the synthesis/simulation reports.

Netlist and requested DEF/LEF exports are included in wall time, CPU and memory. LiveHD internal timing is included in its invocation; the older synthesis report uses compiler stage times. Area here uses common LEF instance geometry. Independent OpenSTA preparation, timing and area collection are excluded. Preparation only elaborates wiring and hierarchy; it never optimizes, maps, prunes dangling cells or lowers native state. Synthesis uses zero-wire timing; placement uses estimated interconnect RC with ideal clocks. No CTS or routing is run.

CPU includes waited-for descendants. Peak memory is the largest individual process peak RSS. Measurements are serial. The incremental column reuses its cold placement workdir; the other columns start fresh. Each LiveHD placement metric pairs Cold | Incr values side by side. These few cases have no headline geomean.

Click a metric header to sort ascending, descending, then restore the original order. Missing values sort last.

OpenROAD’s placement column starts from its retained synthesized netlist: add its synthesis column for RTL-to-placement wall/CPU. LiveHD placement includes synthesis. HighTide uses 8 threads, 50% core utilization and 0.60 target density; LiveHD disables floorplan planning and otherwise keeps compiler defaults, including density. These settings make this a whole-flow comparison rather than an isolated placer test.

LiveHD resynthesis and incremental repeat

The repeat changes no RTL or options and reuses the cold run’s exact --workdir; exports and independent timing use separate outputs. CPU, memory, perf stat and export accounting are the same as for the cold run. Speedup is cold wall ÷ measured wall. OpenROAD is not repeated. A missing resynthesis value means this compiler did not record that stage.

Synthesis covers recorded compiler phases before the first physical/timing stage; ABC is included in synthesis. Resynth pre runs before placement; resynth stage callbacks are nested within physical stages. Place, TD place, resize and repair include their timing callbacks. Region work is the reported per-color ABC check/remap/CEC time within those callbacks. These inclusive times must not be summed. Fired counts include final feedback that can request another run; accepted and restarts record work applied here.
